title: John Lilly's contact with ECCO and Solid State Intelligence

tellings.quote: Yeah. Well, John Lily, who created the isolation tank, claimed to be in contact with two basically forms of non-human intelligence
John Lily, another CIA scientist, develops the sensory deprivation isolation tank. He claims to communicate with an alien intelligence he calls uh SSI.
tellings.difference: Calls Lilly a CIA scientist, names only SSI and not ECCO, and dates the work to the 1950s-1970s.
tellings.link_reason: Same claim that John Lilly, inventor of the isolation tank, was in contact with a non-human intelligence called Solid State Intelligence.

as_told.title: John Lilly's isolation tank and the alien intelligence SSI

tellings.quote: And he spoke to something he called, I think, SSI, this solid state entity. And the solid state entity was this, he described it as this alien being. And the alien being was like, I am manifesting myself on Earth, but in order to manifest, I need more silicon.
tellings.difference: Adds that SSI needed more silicon to manifest on Earth, that the contact happened in the isolation tank, and cites Lilly's Human Biocomputer book.
tellings.link_reason: Same as Lilly's claimed contact with Solid State Intelligence, which the story already holds a telling about.

tellings.link_reason: Same as the ECCO half of the Lilly contact story.

as_told.title: John Lilly's Earth Coincidence Control Office

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells of John Lilly, the man who invented the isolation tank, a dark, silent tank of salt water you float in to cut off your senses. Michels says Lilly claimed to be in contact with two forms of non-human intelligence, one he called ECCO and another he called Solid State Intelligence, or SSI. In a later episode Michels calls Lilly a CIA scientist and mentions only SSI, which would mean, if true, that a government-linked scientist believed he was speaking with something not human.
